title: The Typewriter of the Lower Danube Anew
author: T. M. Blackwood
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
